claims.claim: Bathing well doesn't have to cost much.
claims.note: Voice/atmosphere, not a checkable factual claim.

claims.claim: Plenty of venues in the directory sell a plain adult drop-in: one price, one visit, no package and no treatment attached.
claims.note: General editorial characterisation, not a specific checkable figure.

claims.claim: Those are the ones ranked here, cheapest first, straight from the prices each venue publishes.
claims.note: Describes the methodology; resolved by components, not literal prose claim to verify against records.

claims.claim: A cheap drop-in usually points to one of two things. Either it's a simple, well-run sauna where you pay for the heat and little else, or it's a natural spring where the water does the work and the site is kept plain on purpose.
claims.note: Editorial generalisation, not a specific verifiable factual claim.

claims.claim: Neither is a lesser session. Some of the best ones come from the least adorned rooms.
claims.note: Subjective judgement/voice, not a checkable fact.

claims.claim: The price on the door is the honest number. It's the one figure a venue can't dress up, and the one worth comparing.
claims.note: Editorial opinion, not a verifiable factual claim.

claims.claim: A drop-in is also the fairest thing to line up side by side.
claims.note: Editorial opinion, not a verifiable factual claim.

claims.claim: Package rates fold in towels, robes, a treatment or a meal, and every venue bundles those differently, so the totals stop meaning the same thing.
claims.note: General editorial characterisation; individual bundling details not fully enumerated in records to confirm or deny across all venues.

claims.claim: A single adult entry is like for like.
claims.note: Editorial opinion/methodology description, not a specific checkable fact.

claims.claim: Where a venue only sells packages or treatment-led sessions, it has no plain drop-in to rank, so it stays off this table; there's nothing to compare.
claims.note: Describes editorial methodology, not a specific verifiable fact about a named venue.

claims.claim: Prices move. A venue lifts its weekday rate, a new sauna opens under it, and the order here shifts.
claims.note: General contextual statement about price dynamics, not a specific verifiable claim.

claims.claim: Because this page reads the prices live from the directory, the ranking above is always the current one.
claims.note: Technical/architectural claim about the page, not verifiable from venue records.

claims.claim: It updates itself as venues change what they charge.
claims.note: Technical/architectural claim about the page, not verifiable from venue records.

claims.claim: If you're chasing the lowest cost, start at the top and work down.
claims.note: Editorial instruction, not a checkable factual claim.

claims.claim: To sort by feature or setting instead, the compare hub does that, and the methodology page explains how these prices are checked and dated.
claims.note: Navigation/editorial statement about site features; not verifiable from venue records.
